methodology.scope: Statistical career prospect model using the branch creation, aging, training, rating, ranking, contract and finance functions. Matches and event placements are batch-sampled from the same skill-gap model; this is not a human playtest and does not run full engine rallies.
policies: Trains up to the age cap every week and plays one strongest eligible event or division weekly, respecting one active league and two amateur tournaments per month.
Trains once a fortnight and plays one doubles event a fortnight.
methodology.ratingProDefinition: First time any discipline rating reaches the 4.95 tour floor.
methodology.contractDefinition: First automatic Futures contract offer under the current top-50/recommendation rules.
methodology.proEventDefinition: First Pro League or MLP appearance.
methodology.longScoreRating: Current corrected mode: long scores are normalized to the 11-point rating scale.
caveats: The selected experience profile sets the provisional starting level; compare separate runs before generalizing across player backgrounds.
The model assumes disciplined weekly training and event play for the committed cohort.
CPU opponents are sampled around the entered division rather than replaying the entire regional world.
Full engine rally quality and human input skill are separate variables not modeled here.
